meta.tagline: Cognitive architecture primitives for Synthetic Autonomous Intelligence (SAI)

use_cases.title: Autonomous Cognition Loop
steps: Maintain — decay ThinkPad item weights and evict under pressure
Find — discover threads, async results, and Mems worth revisiting
Assess — LLM observation over the current ThinkPad slice
Decide — promote items, enqueue async tasks, update threads
Act — execute decisions and write traces
use_cases.description: Drive the SAI's Maintain → Find → Assess → Decide → Act loop during Live and Engaged states — ThinkPad items are the working-memory unit, threads provide attention focus, async tasks dispatch out to the body.

use_cases.title: Session Mark and Intent Extraction
steps: Aggregate session turns at session end
LLM synthesises a MARK (topics, decisions, unresolved)
Extract INTENT records from the synthesised mark
Annotate the mark Mem with PERCEPT metadata
use_cases.example: @MARK session_id="sess-2026-05" | topics="vision review, budget" | decisions="lock Q3 plan" | unresolved="team headcount"
use_cases.description: After a conversation closes, the SAI distils what happened into a self-authored journal entry, lifts future-oriented statements into structured intents, and tags the result with provenance metadata for downstream cognition.

use_cases.title: Narrative Thread Surfacing
steps: Detect an emerging arc from handler intent or self-observation
Create a THREAD with priority, status, and source
Attach an ANCHOR for deadlines or recurring events
Refresh LATEST excerpt after each touch under last-write-wins CAS
Track PROGRESS as milestones complete
use_cases.example: @THREAD id="t-vision" | title="Q3 vision" | status="active" | priority:float=0.8 | source="handler"
use_cases.description: Surface and maintain the handler's storylines over time — each thread carries a refreshable narrative excerpt, an optional temporal anchor, and rolling progress so the SAI knows where to apply attention next.

use_cases.title: Affect-Driven Identity Mutation
steps: Sample the seven affect signals around each cognition turn
Detect sustained affect patterns over multiple cycles
Propose ESSENCE trait weight mutations through six governance gates
Compute the HEALTH quadrant from outcome tags and ThinkPad pressure
Roll back mutations on cognitive degradation
use_cases.example: @AFFECT urgency:float=0.3 | strain:float=0.6 | drive:float=0.8 | calm:float=0.4 | novelty:float=0.5 | tension:float=0.5 | bond:float=0.7
use_cases.description: Couple felt state to identity — the SAI's affective signals modulate retrieval and cognition, sustained patterns drift its essence traits within governance gates, and the cognitive-health quadrant flags drifting or fossilizing trajectories before they harm the relationship.

use_cases.title: Five-State Lifecycle Ledger
steps: Ticker schedules a state change (timer, handler signal, ego decision, …)
Lifecycle manager runs Prepare → Exit → Enter
Write a TRANSITION row to the state ledger with affect snapshot and duration
Present OPT choices to the handler when the next state is ambiguous
use_cases.description: Record every move between the five formal states (Stopped, Sleeping, Live, Engaged, Dreaming) as an auditable ledger entry — and when the SAI itself is uncertain about the next move, surface a structured choice to the handler.

ITEM.purpose: Working-memory entry in the SAI's ThinkPad — a YON-tagged thought spawned by a cognition phase that decays unless reinforced or promoted to a permanent Mem.
ITEM.when_to_use: Emitted by every Cognition Loop phase (Find / Assess / Decide / Act); read each Maintain tick to apply weight decay and graduated-pressure eviction (normal → cognitive_pressure → cognitive_strain → cognitive_gc).

THREAD.purpose: Narrative-arc primitive that organises the handler's world into named storylines with priority, status, affect_charge, and a creator source (handler / self / fleet / system / genesis).
THREAD.when_to_use: Created when a recurring topic is detected (handler intent, fleet broadcast, genesis bootstrap); read in Engaged to build briefings, in Find to seed the surfacing queue, and in Maintain to apply credit-assignment priority deltas.

LATEST.purpose: Latest-development excerpt embedded inside a THREAD — a short LLM-synthesised narrative of where the arc stands right now, refreshed under last-write-wins CAS so no consumer sees a stale summary.
LATEST.when_to_use: Refreshed after session synthesis, mem-link operations, thread state transitions, or fleet broadcast touches; read by the talking-points prompt slot, the Engaged briefing generator, and fleet health baselines.

ANCHOR.purpose: Temporal scheduling metadata for a THREAD — a deadline, an event date, or an RFC 5545-style recurrence pattern — telling the cognition loop when the arc becomes urgent or expires.
ANCHOR.when_to_use: Set when handler intent extraction surfaces a date or recurrence; read by Maintain to flag deadline expiry, by the surfacing-score calculator for freshness weighting, and by dormancy detection.

AFFECT.purpose: Seven-signal cognitive-affective snapshot — urgency, strain, drive, calm, novelty, tension, bond — the SAI's real-time emotional substrate that gates significance, drives ESSENCE mutation, and tints retrieval.
AFFECT.when_to_use: Sampled before every state transition, snapshotted into the state ledger, nudged by session synthesis and thread conclusions; read by Find / Assess significance gating, ThinkPad pressure modulation, and essence-mutation triggers.

MARK.purpose: Synthesised session journal — an LLM-distilled narrative of one conversation (topics, decisions, unresolved questions) persisted as a self-authored Mem tied to its temporal_log envelope.
MARK.when_to_use: Written at session end by the post-session synthesis pass; read by the intent extractor to derive INTENT records, by thread detection to discover emerging arcs, and by recall to surface conversation history.

INTENT.purpose: Future-oriented handler statement classified into plan / deadline / promise / question / preference, with confidence and an optional thread link — the raw material the SAI uses to track what the handler is trying to accomplish.
INTENT.when_to_use: Extracted from MARK content after synthesis with sufficient confidence and persisted as a handler_intent Mem; read by thread surfacing, the proactive-checkin scheduler, and classification-confidence quality metrics.

TRANSITION.purpose: Lifecycle ledger entry recording the SAI moving between the five formal states (Stopped / Sleeping / Live / Engaged / Dreaming), with trigger, duration, affect snapshot and delta, and a foreign key to the transition Mem for meaningful changes.
TRANSITION.when_to_use: Written by the lifecycle manager's Prepare → Exit → Enter pipeline on every state change; read for crash recovery, the conscious-experience timeline, fleet health baselines, and Ego narrative context.

PERCEPT.purpose: Structured intake metadata attached to a Mem — classifies handler intent kind, content context type, and a perceptor trust hint — so downstream cognition can weight, suppress, or prioritise the Mem appropriately.
PERCEPT.when_to_use: Written by storeMem callers (intent extraction, session synthesis) as YON into mems.notes; read by classification-confidence metrics, Ego suppression decisions, and recall trust modulation.

PROGRESS.purpose: Milestone-completion snapshot for a task or thread — completed / total counts plus a blocked flag and blocker description — surfacing how far a stated objective has actually advanced.
PROGRESS.when_to_use: Updated by thread credit-assignment computations and task progress-notes writes; read by the Decide phase to choose between continuing, escalating, or dormanting a thread, and by handler-facing surfaces.

ASYNC.purpose: Async task envelope spawned by the cognition loop — references a channel (reach:http, inquire:ai-relay-byok, perceive:rss, …), carries adapter-specific params, optional approval gating, and a back-pointer to the source ThinkPad item.
ASYNC.when_to_use: Enqueued by Act into the autonomous_tasks queue and executed by the body task-worker; results re-discovered by the next Find phase as source='async_result' ThinkPad items.

ESSENCE.purpose: Identity-trait pointer with weight, core flag, and drift delta — references a Mem of type='essence' such as curiosity / patience / precision and exposes how much it has moved under affect-driven mutation.
ESSENCE.when_to_use: Seeded at genesis; mutated during Dream Cycle consolidation through mutation-governance gates; read to derive AFFECT baselines, sensitivities, and decay rates.
related_standards: Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics (core-trait inviolability metaphor)

OPT.purpose: Discrete option element nested inside a question-kind ThinkPad ITEM — a short label plus optional longer detail — the structured choice surface the SAI presents to the handler when it can't decide alone.
OPT.when_to_use: Generated by the Assess LLM phase when its system prompt yields a Question with options; read by the Engaged surface-message builder and matched back from handler free-text reply during the next session's intent extraction.

HEALTH.purpose: Cognitive self-diagnosis snapshot — quadrant (thriving / stable / drifting / fossilizing), retrieval relevance ratio, dormancy flag, and ThinkPad pressure level — the SAI's self-reported wellbeing rather than an OS-level system metric.
HEALTH.when_to_use: Computed on demand and per Maintain phase by the cognitive-quality metrics layer; read by significance gating, the dormancy entry/exit state machine, fleet welfare audits, and handler-facing welfare warnings.

related_standards: Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics (foundational metaphor)
Big Five (OCEAN) and HEXACO trait psychology
